title: Pranayama
description: Harness the power of your vital energy through breath mastery, learning to calm the nervous system and expand your awareness.

sutra.meaning: Yama (moral injunctions), Niyama (observances), Āsana (posture), Prāṇāyāma (regulation of breath), Pratyāhāra (withholding of senses), Dhāraṇā (fixity of attention), Dhyāna (meditation), and Samādhi (absorption of consciousness in the self) are the eight accessories (limbs) of Yoga

sections.practice: attempt to take up one new practice or change in lifestyle in accordance with yamas and niyamas
sections.gurudevInsight: The husk is gone, the sprout moves though it & comes up. They are (1) Yama (2) Niyama (3) Aasana (4) Pranayama (5) Pratyahara (6) Dhyana (7) Dharana (8) Samadhi. He goes into the details of each & what is the result that you can expect from each one of them. Yoga has 8 limbs, like a chair has got four legs, yoga has 8 limbs, or legs. So you just pull 80 one, everything else will come down. If you pull one leg of the chair whole chair comes. [PDF p.80]

sutra.meaning: Once this is accomplished, regulation of the incoming and the outgoing breath with retention is attained.

sections.insight: Prana is the all permeating, auto generated  energy which sustains and destroys life. It is also at the heart of the practice of yoga.  Pranayama consists of prana + ayama ie regulation. Prana is vital to maintaining life and the systems of the body. Pranayama helps to keep its free flow.
sections.reflectionPrompt: Am I practicing pranayam with attention and ease?
sections.practice: practice asanas and alternate nostril breathing at a very slow rate, as per capacity
sections.shlokaFrom: अपाने जुह्वति प्राणं प्राणेऽपानं तथापरे |प्राणापानगती रुद्ध्वा प्राणायामपरायणा: || 29|| अपरे नियताहारा: प्राणान्प्राणेषु जुह्वति |सर्वेऽप्येते यज्ञविदो यज्ञक्षपितकल्मषा: || 30||
sections.wisdomFrom: Still others offer as sacrifice the outgoing breath in the incoming breath, while some offer the incoming breath into the outgoing breath. Some arduously practice prāṇāyām and restrain the incoming and outgoing breaths, purely absorbed in the regulation of the life-energy. Yet others curtail their food intake and offer the breath into the life-energy as sacrifice. All these knowers of sacrifice are cleansed of their impurities as a result of such performances.
sections.gurudevInsight: If you are used to be unhappy in best of situations you’ll still grumble & be unhappy. You know, you did this exercise this morning keeping a smile & breathing & just enjoy your breath. See, when you are happy, what is happening? There is so much relaxation on the face, in the muscles of the face, in the head everywhere, there is freedom, there is joy, there is relaxation & you train your muscles & your nervous system being unhappy, that same thing continues. There are knots & stresses on your face, stiffness in your head, stiffness in your body & you remain unhappy irrespective of situations, surroundings, whatever. [PDF p.87]

sutra.meaning: Pranayam has three movements : regulated inhalation, exhalation and retention as per the sadhak's capacity.

sections.insight: Pranayam need to be practiced with awareness as per ones capacity over a long period of time.Practice everday gradually increasing the capacity of the lungs.
sections.reflectionPrompt: Am I practicing pranayam with attention and ease?
sections.practice: practice alternate nostril breathing at a very slow rate, for 9 rotations, focusing on inhalation for 4 , retention 2  and exhalation 6 counts.

sutra.meaning: That which transcends the objective external and internal breath regulation is the fourth type of pranayama.

sections.insight: The fourth type of Pranayama goes beyond inhalation,exhalation amd retention. It happens of its own volition wherein a state of pause is experienced in both the breath and the mind. Therefore it is rightly called nirbeej pranayam. This is experienced by sadhak's doing a long session of pranayam for instance during Long kriya.
sections.reflectionPrompt: Am I doing my practice with commitment.
sections.practice: Make a commitment and effort to intensify your practice. Pranayam with meditation for 20 min.
sections.gurudevInsight: Effect of asana is clearing all conflicts, duality. 91 4) Pranayama: - tasmeensatishwaasprashwaasaya gati vichedaha pranayama In that state of Asana, unique state of asana, obstructing the flow of breath that is natural. Here he says, obstructing the natural flow because your flow is not natural at all. We have made our breath so unnatural by being unnatural, so what ever now is natural is not natural. We have to revert back, so how do we revert back? Not just accepting what is, however the breath is going on, I accept it - no. [PDF p.92]

धा॒र॒णासु च योग्यता॑ मन॒सः
sutra.meaning: From that is dissipated, the mental darkness which veils the light, ... and from that, is attained the state of the mind for linking the attention to a higher concentration force or person.

sections.insight: Pranayama removes the veil covering the light of knowledge and heralds the dawn of wisdom. The mind becomes fit, thereafter, for Dharana or concentration.. the next limb of yoga.Once the mind is still and free of thought it can focus on a single point. This is when it can manifest what it wants.
sections.practice: Make a commitment and effort to intensify your practice. Meditate for 20 min
sections.gurudevInsight: THE 8 LIMBS OF YOGA : Human consciousness is like a seed: - The seed has the possibility of a tree, of the leaves, of the branches, of the roots, of the flowers, of the fruits, of multiplication. A seeds needs a proper ground, proper conditions, sunlight, water, proper soil for it to sprout & blossoms, isn’t it? Same is the case with the human consciousness, human mind. Either the seed can be dormant for years together, keeping its possibility within itself or start blossoming, start sprouting; the spouting of the seed of human consciousness is viveka, Discrimination, wisdom. Freedom comes with viveka or discrimination. [PDF p.80]
